newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end down on surplus funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end down on surplus funds.

text.p: Pakistan's overnight money market rates closed lower on Tuesday amid excess liquidity and may also open at lower levels on Wednesday, dealers said.
Overnight trading began at four percent but slipped to two percent at close, a dealer at KASB & Co said, adding that major deals were cut at two percent level.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan (SBP) has accepted 10.248 billion rupees at a cut-off yield of 16.90 percent in Monday's auction of six-month short-term federal bonds, he said. The amount would be settled on Wednesday against the maturity of 12.35 billion rupees.
